title: Morning Coffee

brief.premise: A fictional grandmother in an Ethiopian highland village performs the traditional coffee ceremony at dawn: roasting, grinding and pouring for her neighbours.
brief.audience: Ethiopian diaspora families, watching on their phones
brief.intent: Feel the warmth and patience of a daily ritual that ties a community together.

style: warm golden morning light, soft film grain, painterly realism, shallow depth of field

character.name: Almaz
character.description: a fictional elderly Ethiopian woman in a white netela shawl, with a kind lined face and silver earrings

music.prompt: gentle solo krar and soft hand percussion, slow, warm and hopeful

choice.reason: Preferred by the filmmaker after listening: its musical character best suits the film (seed 44).

shots.reason: Establish the quiet dawn and the beginning of the roasting ritual.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Almaz kneels beside a small clay charcoal brazier at dawn, holding a flat long-handled metal pan over the glowing coals and stirring pale green raw coffee beans in it with a short metal stirrer; thin smoke rises from the beans
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle slow push-in on the roasting pan, rising smoke drifting gently across the frame.
shots.narration: Before the sun fully wakes the hills, the roasting begins.
shots.subtitle: Before the sun fully wakes the hills, the roasting begins.
shots.music_cue: Soft traditional wash of krar strings and distant morning birds.

shots.reason: Show the sensory detail of grinding and preparing the jebena.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Almaz kneels on the earth floor pounding dark roasted coffee beans: both hands grip a long wooden pestle raised mid-strike above a tall, deep, narrow traditional wooden mortar (mukecha) standing upright on the ground in front of her, with roasted beans and coarse coffee grounds visible at its rim
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle hand-held camera movement following the rising and falling rhythm of the pestle.
shots.narration: Every tap of the mortar calls the neighborhood close.
shots.subtitle: Every tap of the mortar calls the neighborhood close.
shots.music_cue: Rhythm picks up slightly with a warm ambient pulse.

shots.reason: Conclude with the community gathering for the final pour.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Almaz pours coffee in a thin stream from a traditional black clay jebena, a coffee pot with a round spherical base, a long narrow upright neck, a straight spout and a curved side handle, into small white handleless cups (sini) on a low wooden tray; smiling Ethiopian neighbours from the same highland village, men and women in white netela shawls and traditional dress, sit around her, softly blurred
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth pan from the pouring spout to the joyful faces of the gathered friends.
shots.narration: A shared cup of patience, binding us together.
shots.subtitle: A shared cup of patience, binding us together.
shots.music_cue: Harmonious choral hum fading gently into silence.
